alert.mass_down:
{mentions} 🌐 {down} of {total} apps went down at once: it may be Heartbeat's own network, not the apps. Individual alerts are on hold until it recovers.
{link}
alert.mass_recovered:
🌐 The mass outage is over ({total} monitored apps). Individual alerts resume.
{link}
alert.ping: 🏓 Heartbeat ping: alerts reach this channel.
api.logs_url_refused: The logs URL of '{app}' isn't allowed: {error}
api.monitor_only: '{app}' is monitor-only: it has no logs endpoint
api.not_json: '{app}' answered {status} with a non-JSON body ({bytes} bytes)
apps.alerts_hint: Added to the global ones. https:// webhooks, one per line; mentions by ID, as in ALERT_MENTIONS.
apps.check_assets_hint: For SPA frontends (Vue, React…): checks that every script and stylesheet in the HTML really loads. Catches incomplete deploys that leave a blank page even though the server answers 200.
apps.delete_hint: Removes the app and all its uptime history. It can't be undone.
apps.edit_hint: The slug, embed token and history are kept.
apps.headers_hint: One per line, "Name: value". Sent with every health check.
apps.health_hint: Checked every {secs} s: 2xx is up, over {ms} ms is degraded, anything else is down.
apps.keyword_hint: If the response doesn't contain it, the app counts as down even with a 2xx.
apps.logs_empty_hint: Leave it empty if the app has no logs (e.g. a frontend): only its health is monitored.
apps.logs_hint_b: that returns stdout and stderr as
apps.missing_health: No health URL: not monitored. Add one with "Edit".
apps.name: Name
apps.none: None yet. Use the form to register the first one.
apps.public_off: It has no public status page.
apps.public_on: It has its public page, with no URLs or error messages:
apps.rotate_hint: Invalidates every embed and badge already published with the current token.
apps.sub: Register an app to monitor its health, read its logs and publish its status on other sites.
apps.title: Apps
check.bundle_no_type: Broken bundle: {path} answered with no Content-Type
dash.no_health: This app has no health URL, so it isn't monitored. Add one from

dash.stale_pauses: Paused with no end date for over a day:

err.mention: Unrecognized mention: {entry} (use IDs, as in ALERT_MENTIONS)

err.name_no_alnum: The name needs at least one letter or digit
err.pause_hours: A pause must last between 1 and {max} hours
err.slug_taken: An app with an equivalent name is already registered
err.threshold: The threshold must be a whole number of milliseconds
err.timeout: The timeout must be between 1 and {max} s
err.webhook: Invalid webhook: {url} (must be an https:// URL)
login.bad_response: The login server returned an invalid response.
login.heading: Sign in to Heartbeat
login.no_token: The login didn't return a valid session token.
login.not_admin: Your account doesn't have admin rights.
login.throttled: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.

notices.apps_hint: "All apps" shows it on every published app's status page.

notices.none: No notices. Publish one when an incident affects users.

settings.env_hint: Read-only. Secrets show as set or not set, never their value.
settings.mentions_hint: People are only mentioned when an app goes down, never on recovery.
settings.no_mentions: Nobody gets mentioned when an app goes down. Add
settings.no_mentions_var: Without {mentions}, this alert doesn't mention anyone.
settings.no_webhooks: No global webhooks: only apps with their own webhooks alert. Add
settings.ping_hint: Ping posts a short message to the channel and waits for the service's answer: if you get "pong", alerts get through.
settings.reminder_every: Sent every {mins} min while the app stays down (ALERT_REMIND_MINS).
settings.samples_hint: Edit each alert kind's text with the variables; it applies immediately, no restart needed. Tests say [Test] so nobody mistakes them for an outage.
